text:
Anna: Quick follow-up from design review — proposal: inline 'Preview' in run history so QA can inspect tool outputs without re-running. Mock: https://redwood.in/s/preview-inline
Sam: Inline panel preferred. Keeps timeline context and easier to compare runs.
Rui: Agreed. Make it collapsible per invocation row. Also we must snapshot outputs at execution time so previews are reproducible.
Maya: Important: show if a tool call is side-effecting. Add a red pill 'side-effect' vs green 'read-only'.
Anna: UI sketch: small chevron + label 'Preview' expands an area with tabs: Inputs | Structured | Schema. Add CTA 'Handoff to QA' and 'View raw'.
Sam: Copy nit: consider 'Send to QA' instead of 'Handoff to QA' — feels lighter for internal flows. We'll A/B.
Nick: For long function param lists, collapse to 'n params (show)' with keyboard expand. Defaults show as hover tooltip.
Maya: Accessibility: on expand move focus to the close button; set aria-expanded on the chevron; streaming output should target aria-live polite and aria-atomic false.
Anna: Add a 1-line collapsed summary on the row: "Output: success — 3 keys — schema ok" so reviewers can triage without opening.
Rui: Backend plan: /snapshots endpoint, persist JSON blobs with dedupe by content-hash, retention 90 days. Expose snapshot_id in run history metadata.
Nick: Perf note: structured tree must virtualize deep nodes to avoid jank on huge responses.
Maya: Visual contrast: CTA currently low-contrast — bump to brand color to meet AA.
qa-bot: Ticket created: #234 "run-history: inline preview + snapshot" https://redwood.in/t/234
Anna: Thanks all — I'll update Figma and add a11y annotations. Sam, can you draft copy variants? Rui please scope snapshot API. Nick prototype keyboard expander?
Sam: Will do. :thumbsup:
Rui: On it.
Anna: Great progress, thanks everyone!
